title: City council approves monsoon drainage plan
text: City council approves monsoon drainage plan Front page">The Daily Example City council approves monsoon drainage plan CHENNAI, 4 June 2026 — The city council on Tuesday approved a ₹1,200-crore plan to widen 140 km of storm-water drains before the north-east monsoon, after three years in which the same streets flooded. "We will not wait for the next flood," the mayor said. Work on 38 stretches starts in July; the rest by September. Rainfall icon What changes for residents Road closures, announced a week ahead on the council website. Night work in residential areas only between 10 pm and 5 am. Complaints to ward offices, or by phone on 1913. Related Last year's flood report © 2026 The Daily Example
